skills.name: carrousel
skills.description: Compose, review or improve the content of an image carousel (multi-image post) — hooks, per-slide titles, captions, calls to action and publication order. Use when the user shares carousel images or data from the Studio IA Carrousel tab, or asks to write carousel copy.

skills.name: Navigation assistée TikTok
skills.description: Contrôle manuel de TikTok sur un Android connecté à Switch, une action explicite à la fois, sans automatisation d’engagement ni imitation anti-détection.

skills.name: Publier une vidéo sur les réseaux
skills.description: Publier une vidéo (mp4) générée par le Studio IA ou fournie par l'utilisateur sur TikTok, Instagram (Reels/publication) ou YouTube, en pilotant l'application du téléphone Android branché en USB à Switch et en laissant l'utilisateur choisir le compte et l'audience dans l'app. Use when the user asks to post, publish, upload, partager, publier, poster ou mettre en ligne une vidéo sur les réseaux sociaux, including across multiple platforms. Télécommande assistée : chaque action est proposée à partir d'une capture d'écran fraîche et confirmée par l'utilisateur.

skills.name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
skills.description: Use for EVERY code review and before every commit or PR in this project (app + website) — an extremely strict maintainability audit: abstraction quality, files crossing 1000 lines, spaghetti conditionals, boundary/type cleanliness, and ambitious "code judo" simplifications. Apply any time you write, refactor, or restructure code.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.description: Use when designing, redesigning, critiquing, auditing, polishing, distilling, hardening, or otherwise improving a frontend interface — websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, onboarding, empty states. Covers visual hierarchy, spacing, layout, color, typography, fonts, motion/micro-interactions, accessibility, responsive behavior, theming, anti-patterns/AI-slop, and design systems/tokens. In THIS project it also backs the toolbar "Audit" button (the Impeccable browser detector). Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.

skills.name: make-interfaces-feel-better
skills.description: Design engineering principles for making interfaces feel polished. Use when building UI components, reviewing frontend code, implementing animations, hover states, shadows, borders, typography, micro-interactions, enter/exit animations, or any visual detail work. Triggers on UI polish, design details, "make it feel better", "feels off", stagger animations, border radius, optical alignment, font smoothing, tabular numbers, image outlines, box shadows.

skills.name: dockerize-git
skills.description: Use when a user gives a Git URL and wants the project analyzed, packaged as an exportable Docker image, or deployed quickly to a Linux VPS.
